title: reconstructPriorOrchCumulative replays the whole event log (all issues, all pas…
body: reconstructPriorOrchCumulative replays the whole event log (all issues, all past orchestrator sessions) to derive the prior cumulative. On a real orchestrator-session boundary (transcript reset -> smaller cumulative than the accumulated baseline), Math.max(0, ...) correctly floors the delta at 0, but the baseline is NOT reset, so the first several post-reset cycles under-count (floor to 0) until the new cumulative exceeds the old accumulated baseline. This is within the story's explicitly-sanctioned best-effort recovery (no session-id on the event) and prevents the quadratic inflation being fixed, so it is non-blocking; the patterns.md bullet's phrasing 'count the whole new cumulative as this cycle's delta' is slightly optimistic for this multi-cycle post-reset case. Consider a session-boundary reset of the baseline if per-cycle accuracy after orchestrator restarts becomes important.
